item.title: Lagos Judiciary swears in 130 new Notaries Public
item.description: The Lagos State Judiciary has inducted 130 new Notaries Public as part of efforts to improve public access to notarisation and document authentication services across the state. The development aligns with ongoing reforms within the judiciary aimed at strengthening service delivery in Lagos, Nigeria’s commercial hub, where the demand for certified legal documentation remains high […] Lagos Judiciary swears in 130 new Notaries Public

item.title: Lagos court jails Adonai Institute provost for forging LASU result notification
item.description: A Lagos State High Court in Ikeja has sentenced Samson Orijugo, provost of Adonai Advanced Institute of Management, to three years in prison after finding him guilty of forging an official notification of result bearing the letterhead of Lagos State University, LASU. item.title: Borno: Police launch manhunt for suspect over rape of five-year-old girl
item.description: Borno State Police Command says it is on the manhunt for Abdulsalam Adakwaki, who allegedly raped a five-year-old girl in the State Low-Cost area of Maiduguri, the state capital. The command clarified that reports claiming the suspect had been arrested and released were false. The state police Public Relations Officer, Nahum Daso, said in a […] Borno: Police launch manhunt for suspect over rape of five-year-old girl

item.title: Insecurity: NLC suspends planned protest in Sokoto, holds prayers
item.description: The Nigeria Labour Congress, NLC, Sokoto State chapter, has suspended its planned street protest over worsening insecurity and resolved to hold special prayers for peace and safety across the state. item.title: Ex-governor Bafarawa’s supporters defect from PDP to APC in Sokoto
item.description: Supporters of former Sokoto State governor, Alhaji Attahiru Bafarawa, under the banner of the Bafarawa Akida Movement, have formally defected from the Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, to the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC, in the state. item.title: Five Lagos, Osun herbalists face trial over fake $3m, €280,000
item.description: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission, EFCC, has announced plans to arraign five herbalists arrested at different shrines in Lagos and Osun states over the alleged possession of counterfeit foreign currencies totalling about $3.4 million and €280,000. item.title: Gombe PDP ex-guber candidate, Barde defects to ADC
item.description: Gombe State’s 2023 Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, gubernatorial candidate, Mohammad Barde, has formally joined the African Democratic Congress, ADC. Barde, who came second in Gombe State’s 2023 governorship election behind Governor Inuwa Yahaya, said he joined the ADC as part of his preparations for the 2027 general elections.
